after.scope: Actual Chromium DOM and production inspection service through Playwright tab/storage adapters; loopback synthetic fixtures, same conditions before/after. Native MV3 service-worker/DNR transport and Burp GUI are not verified.

nativeExtension.reason: Managed system Chromium extension policy rejects unpacked helper installation. Policy was not changed. Actual MV3/DNR and native Burp GUI were not executed.

limitations: DOM settling is bounded and heuristic; delayed content on a non-empty page can appear after its quiet window. It is not a proof that every menu/function has been explored.
Empty leaf documents wait to the 3-second bound and remain conservatively partial even when reached; no invisible content is assumed.
Before/after checks describe expected behavior and overlap; they are not added to default regression totals.
Playwright tab/storage adapters run the production browser service on actual Chromium DOM. DNR rule construction/lifetime tests do not verify native extension transport.

supplementalDomGuardSuite.scope: Actual Chromium page DOM and production inspection.js functions with an isolated profile and loopback fixture; no helper installation, MV3 service worker, DNR, Burp GUI or manual permission verification.
